name: bytune-desktop
author: ByTune
description: ByTune — desktop music player for Windows & macOS

scripts.dev:app: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/build-main.mjs && esbuild electron/po-page.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist-electron/po-page.js && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('electron/po.html','dist-electron/po.html')" && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('electron/assets','dist-electron/assets',{recursive:true})" && node scripts/build-media-helper.mjs
scripts.test: esbuild src/lib/account-validators.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/account-validators.mjs && esbuild src/lib/config.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/config.mjs && esbuild electron/sync-merge.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/sync-merge.mjs && esbuild electron/audio-format.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/audio-format.mjs && esbuild electron/backup-transfer.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/backup-transfer.mjs && esbuild electron/market.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/market.mjs && esbuild electron/ytm.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/ytm.mjs && esbuild electron/local-paths.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/local-paths.mjs && esbuild src/lib/deletion-sync.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/deletion-sync.mjs && esbuild src/lib/download-reconcile.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/download-reconcile.mjs && esbuild electron/mac-menu.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/mac-menu.mjs && esbuild electron/close-to-tray.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/close-to-tray.mjs && esbuild electron/window-state.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/window-state.mjs && esbuild src/lib/media-key-tap.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/media-key-tap.mjs && esbuild src/lib/audio-output.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/audio-output.mjs && esbuild src/lib/radio-filter.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/radio-filter.mjs && esbuild src/lib/lyricsLines.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/lyrics-lines.mjs && esbuild src/lib/replayFormat.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/replay-format.mjs && esbuild src/lib/playlistShare.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/playlist-share.mjs && esbuild src/lib/format.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/format.mjs && esbuild src/lib/romanize.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/romanize.mjs && esbuild src/lib/analysis.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/analysis.mjs && esbuild electron/lyrics.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --external:jsdom --outfile=.test-build/lyrics.mjs && esbuild src/lib/swipeNav.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/swipeNav.mjs && esbuild src/lib/moodMix.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.test-build/moodMix.mjs && esbuild electron/m4a-tags.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.test-build/m4a-tags.mjs && esbuild electron/audio-types.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.test-build/audio-types.mjs && esbuild electron/track-match.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.test-build/track-match.mjs && esbuild electron/spotify-web.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=.test-build/spotify-web.mjs && node scripts/with-test-temp.mjs node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.dist: cross-env BYTUNE_RELEASE=1 npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: cross-env BYTUNE_RELEASE=1 npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: cross-env BYTUNE_RELEASE=1 npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:arm64: cross-env BYTUNE_RELEASE=1 npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:x64: cross-env BYTUNE_RELEASE=1 npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64
